content.text: Tickets submitted through the Billing Questions form are routed into the general Triage queue instead of the Billing Questions queue.
Routing rules still key off an old form id after the form rebuild, so billing work waits behind unrelated triage volume.
Update the router mapping for the current form id, move misrouted open tickets, and add a canary assertion on form-to-queue binding.
